routes.GET /organizations: items: confirmed profile records; presets: four editable profile objects; can_manage: boolean
routes.POST /organizations: body: profile, expected_revision, confirmed=true; returns confirmed record
routes.POST /distribution/seed: body: confirmed=true; returns source resource IDs
routes.POST /distribution/run: body: run_id, variant=identifier-leak|corrected, confirmed=true; returns run
routes.GET /distribution/runs/:id: returns run including branches and optional audit records
routes.POST /distribution/audit: body: run_id, acknowledge_cost=true, acknowledge_synthetic=true; bounded to 3 reviews and 6 model requests for this run; returns run

profile_record: id, revision, profile, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, hash
run: id, variant, state, created_at, profiles, source_pins, branches[], error (optional)
branch: id=quality|research|clinic, organization, protocol=SQL|REST|HL7, namespace, state, message_id, session_id, fields[], payload_hash, receipt (optional), policy_mismatches[], audit (optional), error (optional)
audit: state, assessment, explanation, next_step, report_id, model_requests, raw
operating_boundary: post-send advisory only; presets are drafts; no automatic send or model call; synthetic local targets only
